title: Are you ready?
html:
Last night I wrote in my journal: "Ready! I am ready for the week ahead" and thought that could be a great starting point for a MondayMotivator.

First of all, yes, I have a journal I write in every night. Sometimes not much and then other times it just pours out. It's very interesting what comes out though and I feel positive it gets all those last thoughts out of my head so I can go to sleep, something that doesn't happen easily if I have lots of ideas floating around. I highly recommend keeping a journal, if not just for you, then for your kids or family.

This week I am pumped for the week ahead, but that isn't always the case. Thinking about that I tried to pinpoint what makes me so pumped for the week in this instance and I couldn't work it out. What makes one week different from another? It's just seven days, right?

Right now I am enjoying working with Lauren and we are doing some great work at Spikemail as a lot of our clients are really starting to see the value in their databases. This makes work exciting and the weekend is a bit of a pain because it stops my flow. Also, I have cut down on my meetings and am making calls instead. I'm still getting the contact, but don't have to sit in traffic.

So, I still don't think I have the answer, it could just be that the weekend is over and I can get my flow back again. I would like to hear your ideas on this.

Have a terrific week.
